WARNING_SENTINELS.rule: NEVER cast a flag column in this file with astype(bool). Use == 1.
WARNING_SENTINELS.why: Three of the four flag columns are float with NaN where the transcript has no GENCODE CDS. NaN is TRUTHY, so astype(bool) selects the 61.2% of rows that mean 'not applicable'. The same information in the h5 is int8 with a -1 sentinel, which is also truthy. This cost the model window three wrong numbers on 2026-08-02 (job 8900473 supersedes the contaminated run) and no check caught it; it was found by an arithmetic ceiling -- 40,914 transcripts claimed against 16,655 that have a GENCODE CDS at all.

SECOND_TRAP: has_gencode_cds is a TRANSCRIPT-level flag repeated on every candidate row: 311,581 rows against 16,655 transcripts. Counting rows where it is 1 does not count transcripts. Group and take max.
